question: What claim about the speaker's intention is made by promising to speak the method of names for them and urging the beautiful-eyed one to hear?
premises: The speaker will speak the method of names for them.
The recipient is urged to hear.
The address is to the beautiful-eyed one.
inference: The speaker declares an intention to disclose the method of names, calling on the recipient to attend.
uncertainties: The referent of teṣām is not recoverable from this verse alone.
plain_english: I shall speak the method of their names; hear, O beautiful-eyed one.
